tool.name: Biomni: Analyze Cell Migration Metrics
tool.description: Analyze cell migration metrics from time-lapse microscopy images.

param.name: image_sequence_path
param.label: Image Sequence Path
param.help: Path to the directory containing time-lapse images or path to a multi-frame TIFF file

param.name: pixel_size_um
param.label: Pixel Size Um
param.help: Conversion factor from pixels to micrometers (default: 1.0)

param.name: time_interval_min
param.label: Time Interval Min
param.help: Time interval between consecutive frames in minutes (default: 1.0)

param.name: min_track_length
param.label: Min Track Length
param.help: Minimum number of frames a cell must be tracked to be included in analysis (default: 10)

tool.help:
**Biomni: Analyze Cell Migration Metrics**
Analyze cell migration metrics from time-lapse microscopy images.
Parameters ---------- image_sequence_path : str Path to the directory containing time-lapse images or path to a multi-frame TIFF file pixel_size_um : float Conversion factor from pixels to micrometers (default: 1.0) time_interval_min : float Time interval between consecutive frames in minutes (default: 1.0) min_track_length : int Minimum number of frames a cell must be tracked to be included in analysis (default: 10) output_dir : str Directory to save output files (default: "./")
Returns ------- str Research log summarizing the cell migration analysis process and results
**Domain**: bioengineering **Function**: analyze_cell_migration_metrics
